For [dataframe](/docs/shell/commands/categories/dataframe/).

<div class='command-title'>Creates a not expression.</div>

> **warning This command requires a plugin**
> The `polars expr-not` command resides in the `polars` plugin.
> To use this command, you must install and register `nu_plugin_polars`.
> See the [Plugins](/docs/shell/book/plugins/) chapter in the book for more information.



## Command Type

`plugin`

## Signature

```> polars expr-not {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input             | output            |
| ----------------- | ----------------- |
| polars_expression | polars_expression |
| polars_selector   | polars_expression |
## Examples

Creates a not expression
```nu
> (polars col a) > 2) | polars expr-not

```

Adds a column showing which values of col a are not greater than 2
```nu
> [[a]; [1] [2] [3] [4] [5]] | polars into-df
                    | polars with-column [(((polars col a) > 2)
                    | polars expr-not
                    | polars as a_expr_not)]
                    | polars collect
                    | polars sort-by a
╭───┬───┬───────╮
│ # │ a │   b   │
├───┼───┼───────┤
│ 0 │ 1 │ true  │
│ 1 │ 2 │ true  │
│ 2 │ 3 │ false │
│ 3 │ 4 │ false │
│ 4 │ 5 │ false │
╰───┴───┴───────╯

```
